title: standardizeMissing
summary: Replace user-specified missing indicators with canonical missing values.

gpu_support.notes: Standardization is host work. Automatically resident supported inputs gather through their owning provider. An explicitly resident indicator is a separately gated RunMat extension, checked before provider access.

description: `standardizeMissing(A, indicators)` replaces user-defined sentinel values with the missing representation appropriate for each input variable. Floating numeric matches become `NaN`, text matches become the missing string sentinel, and table or container inputs are processed recursively. Integer indicators are documented when they identify values in supported floating data. A direct native-integer array has no standard missing value, so RunMat mode treats it as an exact class-preserving no-op; that additional input form is rejected in MATLAB-compatible mode.
behaviors: Numeric arrays accept scalar or array indicators; `NaN` indicators match existing NaNs.
String arrays and character-array rows accept text indicators and are converted to the missing string sentinel.
Cell arrays and tables are processed recursively.
All eight integer classes can be used as numeric indicators for supported floating data without enabling RunMat extensions.
Integer variables inside a table retain their native class and values because standard integer classes have no canonical missing element.

Passing a native integer array directly as `A` is a named RunMat extension. It returns the original typed storage unchanged and is rejected in MATLAB-compatible mode before any resident input is gathered.
